arcade-reef-intro: Let’s build a reef. Drag a coral piece into an open space. You can also tap a piece, then tap its spot. Full rows or columns release little fish. There is no hurry.
arcade-reef-ten: These corals have numbers. Put six beside four. Together they make ten, and the fish can swim free.
arcade-song-intro: Listen to the shells and watch them glow. When it is your turn, tap the same shells in the same order. You can listen again whenever you like.
arcade-song-word: These shells hold sounds. Tap the sounds in order, then blend them together. Which picture matches your word? Take your time.
arcade-chest: This chest shows its sticker before you open it. Try one little question, ask for help, or skip it. Your stars are already yours.
arcade-rest: You have been playing for a little while. Would you like a stretch or a drink of water? Your stars are saved.
arcade-phoneme-b: The sound at the start of bus.
arcade-phoneme-c: The sound at the start of cat.
arcade-phoneme-d: The sound at the start of dog.
arcade-phoneme-g: The sound at the start of gum.
arcade-phoneme-h: The sound at the start of hat.
arcade-phoneme-n: The sound at the start of net.
arcade-phoneme-p: The sound at the start of pig.
arcade-phoneme-s: The sound at the start of sun.
arcade-phoneme-t: The sound at the start of tap.
arcade-cargo-intro: Fill a row to send a canoe. Move the cargo, turn it, then drop it into a gap.
arcade-cargo-sum: Fill a row and count its numbers. Match the target to send two canoes. Helper lets you take your time.
arcade-cargo-goal: Pack the gaps. Send the canoes!
arcade-cargo-sum-goal: Match the target sum. Send two canoes!
arcade-flight-intro: Tap to flap. Follow the glowing fruit. Let your wings glide between the palm leaves.
arcade-flight-math: Fly through the answer. Look at the sum, then flap into the gate with its number. A wrong answer comes around again.
arcade-run-intro: Swipe to steer. Jump up. Duck down. Collect shells along the lagoon. You can tap the arrows too.
arcade-run-math: Run into the answer lane. Look at the sum, then follow the lane with its number. A wrong answer comes around again.
arcade-rail-intro: Lead the chicks home. Swipe or tap an arrow to turn. Watch for the edge, your parade, and the brown tree snake.
arcade-rail-learn: One swipe, one step. Collect the numbers in order, or find the letters for your picture. There is no hurry.
arcade-crab-intro: Look, hop, ride. Tap an arrow to hop. Look for a gap in the traffic, ride the logs, and reach your seaside burrow.
arcade-crab-learn: Hop to the next number. Count on, count back, or skip count. The lagoon waits for you. There is no hurry.
arcade-palm-intro: Slide to aim. Tap to toss beetles into nets!
arcade-palm-math: Toss at the answer that matches. Take your time.
arcade-beach-intro: Drag your paddle. Bounce the ball past your buddy!
arcade-beach-together: Drag your paddle. Play from opposite ends!
arcade-beach-count: Return the ball. Count each splash together!
